title: review follow-ups of PR #37643: screen-input refusal `fields` wording (one entry per finding, stale code jsdoc)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7199938860 on PR #37643, nits N1 and N2, adopted at ACCEPT)

## What happens

PR #37643 (Fixes #37526) returns the screen-input refusal's per-field findings as `error.details.fields` on flow resume (REST and MCP `resume_run`). Its review left these wording items open:

- [ ] **"one entry per violated field" is really one entry per finding** (N1). The contract jsdoc and the `TriggerFlowResponseSchema.data.fields` describe say one entry per violated field, and the regenerated reference page, `content/docs/**/flows.mdx` and the changeset repeat it. A `required` `record_link` field sent `null`, or a field with `min` above `max`, yields two entries; for `unknown_field` the `field` is the caller's key, not a screen field name. Expected: say "one entry per finding" and name the `unknown_field` case.
- [ ] **`ScreenInputIssue.code` jsdoc is stale** (N2). `screen-input-contract.ts` still says the codes "ride inside the refusal's message"; they now ride `fields`. Expected: point the comment at `error.details.fields`.

Category ①: published contract text (schema describe, reference page) that miscounts what a shipped response carries.
Priority: p3, wording; no code reads the sentence.
Business reason: an SDK or agent caller that sizes its error display by "one per field" shows duplicate rows on these two cases without knowing why.
Reader: the dev who next edits the automation screen-input contract (spec describe → regenerate the reference page).
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37643"`: 0 hits.
Related: #37526, PR #37643.

## Grade

area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against the describe) · evidence: read → p3
